entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Densely forested area in southeast Terisiare during the Ice Age, home to elves and druids who worshiped Freyalise.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess of nature worshiped by Fyndhorn elves; cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Neighboring nation with which Fyndhorn elves traded.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell cast by Freyalise that brought the Thaw.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Thaw of Terisiare after the World Spell.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event that swallowed most of Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Island remaining clear of the waves.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island remains in whose shadow Fyndhorn grew.

events.summary: Fyndhorn emerges from the sea floor as glaciers lower sea levels at the start of the Ice Age.
events.quote: the sea levels sank, revealing Fyndhorn from the ocean floor

events.summary: The elves of Fyndhorn establish trading ties with Kjeldor.
events.quote: established trading ties with the neighboring nation of Kjeldor

events.summary: After Freyalise's World Spell the Thaw and Flooding swallow most of Fyndhorn, and survivors migrate to Yavimaya.
events.quote: Many of the forest's former inhabitants migrated to Yavimaya to establish a new home there.

relations.quote: Kelsinko was the main city in the forest.

relations.note: Its elves and druids worshiped her as goddess of nature.
relations.quote: who worshiped Freyalise as a goddess of nature
